overview: Harper is a cynical private eye in the best tradition of Bogart. He even has Bogie's Baby hiring him to find her missing husband, getting involved along the way with an assortment of unsavory characters and an illegal-alien smuggling ring.
tagline: Harper takes a case - and the payoff is murder.

recs.blurb: A woman framed for her husband's murder suspects he is still alive; as she has already been tried for the crime, she can't be re-prosecuted if she finds and…
Private investigator Matthew Scudder is hired by a drug kingpin to find out who kidnapped and murdered his wife.
A doctor hires an escort to seduce her husband, whom she suspects of cheating, though unforeseen events put the family in danger.
An elderly ex-serviceman and widower looks to avenge his best friend's murder by doling out his own form of justice.
A woman turns to prescription medication as a way of handling her anxiety concerning her husband's upcoming release from prison.
A former thief frantically searches for his missing daughter, who has been kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a taxi.
A chilling vision of the House of Saddam Hussein comes to life through the eyes of the man who was forced to become the double of Hussein's sadistic son.
Two brothers, on either side of the law, face off over organized crime in Brooklyn during the 1970s.
An employee of a corporation with a lucrative secret process is tempted to betray it. But there's more to it than that.
A corrupt cop gets in over his head when he tries to assassinate a beautiful Russian hit-woman.
In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is seduced by a woman seeking retribution.
